[USER] User asked how to create a white noise layer instrument in Logic Pro.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To create a white noise layer instrument in Logic Pro, the assistant provided a step-by-step guide:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Create a new software instrument track by going to File > New > Software Instrument Track.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. In the channel strip for the new track, select an empty instrument plugin slot by clicking on it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. From the plugin menu, choose "ES2," which is a synthesizer that comes with Logic Pro.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. In the ES2 interface, select "Init Patch" to start with a blank slate.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. In the oscillator section, set the first oscillator to "White Noise" by clicking on the waveform display and selecting it from the menu.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Adjust the envelope settings to taste, suggesting a short attack and decay time and a sustain level of 0 for a simple white noise layer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Adjust any other settings in the ES2 as desired, such as filtering or modulation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Play some notes on the software instrument track to hear the white noise layer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. To further customize the sound, add effects plugins to the channel strip, such as EQ or distortion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant concluded that the user now has a white noise layer instrument in Logic Pro.  
[USER] User asked how to modify the pitch of the white noise layer instrument.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To modify the pitch, the assistant provided two methods:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Using the Pitch Bend function:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Click on the software instrument track to select it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - In the Piano Roll Editor, select the notes you want to modify.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Click on the Pitch Bend button in the toolbar (it looks like a line with an arrow pointing up and down).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Click and drag the pitch bend line up or down to raise or lower the pitch of the selected notes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Transposing the MIDI notes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Click on the software instrument track to select it.
